source.check: the no-election report read in the Lurgan Mail of 22 May 1964.

note: Triennial election of Moira Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was no contest. Six divisions were filled; Clare was entered blank in the notice of result because no candidate was nominated, and the division is therefore left unrepresented in this record. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
